text:
maria.s: Customer reports sudden 502/504s on hosted API around a model swap. Affects /v1/embeddings only when requests include large metadata headers (~5-8KB). They say it started at rollout time. CC @alex.r @jamie.k

alex.r: looking at edge logs now — I see a pattern: upstream RST_STREAM from midproxy, lots of conn_window_exhausted traces. example trace id: trc-98a3f. collecting h2 diagnostic dump.

jamie.k: runtime note — the new embedding variant added an extra response header (X-Model-Variant) and seems to extend response head processing. not sure why that would trigger 502/504s, but increased header size + long tails can hit h2 windows. any recent envoy/nginx tunings?

maria.s: customer provided a curl repro, pasting minimal: 

```
curl -v \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Customer-Meta: $(head -c 6000 /dev/zero | base64)" \n  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
They see 502 then subsequent 504s under burst.

deploy-bot: deploy canary: model-embed-v2 -> 20% finished at 2026-03-18T12:05:10Z by ci-cd (canary rollout id: canary-20260318-09)

matt.oncall: I ran the curl loop locally against eu1 frontdoor with 100 concurrent clients, keepalive off, big X-Customer-Meta. Repro: ~38% 502 within 30s. tcp captures show upstream FIN mid-response, and envoy reports stream reset with error code: ENVOY_RESET: connection failure (RST_STREAM).

olivia.cs: customer is on EU region and is escalating to SEV for billing impacted tenants. they want ETA and temporary workaround.

alex.r: mitigation options: 1) yank canary back to 0% (rollback) 2) short-term edge config: cap header size or drop oversized metadata 3) upstream keepalive/h2 window tweaks. I'll push rollback first.

jamie.k: also recommend adding a short-term response header scrub to strip X-Model-Variant for now so responses are smaller, and enable prefix kv cache so common inputs hit cache and reduce RPS.

maria.s: rolling canary down to 0% now (canary-20260318-09 -> 0%). will monitor edge error rate and customer callbacks.

deploy-bot: canary update: model-embed-v2 -> 0% (rollback) completed at 2026-03-18T12:07:42Z

alex.r: error rate on /v1/embeddings dropped from 18% to 1.2% in the EU frontdoor within ~90s of rollback. collecting post-rollback traces to confirm no regressions.

maria.s: notified customer and provided workaround: trim metadata headers or send metadata in body until we ship a header-limit policy. they confirmed immediate improvement.

olivia.cs: customer still wants a postmortem and timeline. we'll schedule a follow-up with eng-runtime and eng-sre.

matt.oncall: followups for eng-runtime: investigate why extra response header + larger response size causes upstream to RST_STREAM under h2 window pressure. also check midproxy conn window defaults and idle keepalive behavior.

jamie.k: opened a ticket in eng-runtime backlog: RT-embed-622 "h2 window and header-size interaction causing upstream resets under embedding canary". adding reproducer and tcp captures.

maria.s: closing the immediate escalation (customer satisfied for now). leaving thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
